title: Tight CCA Security for TEM Beyond Two Rounds
summary: Adaptive CCA analysis falls short of the conjectured query threshold; proving tight TEM CCA security for every round count above two remains open.

formal_statement.body: For every $r>2$, establish tight CCA security of $\operatorname{TEM}[n,r,H]$ up to $q\approx 2^{rn/(r+1)}$ queries.

scope.domain: Security bounds for the tweakable Even–Mansour block-cipher construction.
assumptions: The round count r is greater than two.
parameters: H: parameter of the TEM construction
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish tight CCA security of TEM for every round count above two up to the stated conjectured query level.

progress.summary: The paper explicitly presents tight analysis of TEM for more than two rounds as an open problem and suggests a tight CLRW analysis for the same round range as a simpler first step. The supplied context reports an adaptive CCA bound below the conjectured threshold, which is established only for NCPA.
citation_labels: Benoît Cogliati et al., Tweaking Even-Mansour Ciphers
